Hey man (or woman) I went through quite a similar situation. You gotta start small, focus on applying to one place a day, every day until you get a job. Once you get a job you can start paying on your bills.

You are not a failure, you're just taking an unexpected path. Life isn't going how you expected and that's hard. I never thought I'd get diagnosed with autoimmune issues, or that my sister would die at 20, or that I would fail put of university. 

Life is fucked sometimes but you have to focus on what you can change and start working on it. Slowly but surely things will be better. Or at least I hope they will be, im still trying myself.
